name: Mercedes-Benz 1:43 Miniature Model
about: A small scale model of a Mercedes-Benz car, sold as an official licensed product. Stuttgart is the home of the car industry, so this makes a fitting memento of the city.
tip: Check that the model is officially licensed before you buy.

name: Stuttgart Trollinger Wine
about: A red wine made from the Trollinger grape, a local variety. Stuttgart has a long tradition of growing grapes on its city vineyards.
tip: Check the grape variety and vintage on the label before you buy.
